messages:
Alice Chen: Quick sync — I'm drafting a marketplace SKU-deprecation + renewal play. Main goal: avoid churn when we sunset old reserved SKUs and give customers a clean path to migrate to new commit tiers. Looking for ideas on a consumption-velocity safeguard and how we layer onboarding credits.
Miguel Torres: Love it. For safeguards — we should throttle price deltas per-customer. e.g., if the effective unit price increases >15% vs last quarter, hold for a 30d grace or auto-apply migration credits.
Priya Nair: Agree. Also add a minimum-usage smoothing window: spread the remaining credit across 3 invoices so customers don't see a big jump.
Jordan Patel: For appliance/hw partners we need a joint message — "no change to reserved performance, just SKU re-labeling" and an opt-in migration tool in the console. Keeps SIs calm.
Samir Rao: Proposed tactical options: 1) phased SKU sunset (by cohort), 2) one-time migration credit, 3) rolling price floor for legacy accounts. Also consider an "automatic carryover" for leftover committed $ into the new SKU at a small haircut.
Alice Chen: Good list. Priya — can you sketch the cohort rules? Ex: cohort A = active >90d + >80% utilization get 90d notice and auto-migrate. Cohort B = <60d or low usage get 120d and a manual opt-in.
Priya Nair: Yep — draft: 
- Cohort A: >90d active, >80% consumption of commit => 90d notice + auto-convert + 10% migration credit
- Cohort B: 30–90d active or elasticity users => 120d notice + guided migration + 20% staggered credit
- Cohort C: <30d or paused => 180d notice + advisory only
Miguel Torres: Thinking on renewals: tie the renewal window to usage velocity. If a customer's 30-day velocity hits 2x baseline during migration, we lock them into the new SKU pricing but extend renewal by 30d to give them runway. Helps capture growth without surprise.
Jordan Patel: Messaging: we should co-author an SI/partner Q&A doc with sample lines: "Why are SKUs changing? -> To simplify commit tiers and lower unit costs long-term." Keep it short.
Alice Chen: Can we show a config snippet for a safeguard rule in the console? Something simple devs can read: 
```
policy {
  safeguard: {
    max_delta_pct: 15
    grace_period_days: 30
    cohort_action: "auto_migrate|manual_contact"
  }
}
```
Samir Rao: Nice. Ops note: we need to ensure billing shows a clear line item: "migration credit" so CSMs can explain the offset on invoice. Also add an audit event for migration.
marketplace-bot: Draft private-offer created: offer-id=po_202safeguard_v1, link=https://console.redwood/in/po/po_202safeguard_v1
Priya Nair: Suggest adding an "early-adopter bonus" for partners that help migrate >10 customers in first 90d — a pooled SI rebate.
Miguel Torres: +1 to rebate. Also propose a sunset chart for the partner playbook with milestones: notice -> migration window -> grace -> final cutoff.
Alice Chen: Perfect. Action items: Priya to finalize cohort rules + credit math by EOW; Jordan to draft partner Q&A; Samir to scope billing implementation; Miguel to draft renewal/velocity clause. I'll put these in a GH issue and tag CSMs.
Priya Nair: On it.
Jordan Patel: Will start the Q&A draft and ping APAC partners for timezone-friendly comms.
Samir Rao: I'll scope billing changes and add telemetry hooks.
Miguel Torres: I'll write the renewal clause and example scenarios.
Alice Chen: Thanks team — we'll sync Thursday 10am PT to review the first pass. :calendar:
